mapper.sql: id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, message_id, user_id, read_flag
mapper.select: SELECT um.id, um.message_id AS messageId, um.read_flag AS readFlag, um.created_at AS createdAt, m.title, m.category, m.content FROM sys_user_message um INNER JOIN sys_message m ON um.message_id = m.id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId} AND um.read_flag = 0 AND m.enabled = 1 ORDER BY m.seq DESC, um.created_at DESC
